Maria (CS): Quick check-in on Skyline Labs onboarding — seeing a noticeable dip in token throughput this week. TL;DR: tokens WoW -22%, QoQ -5%. P50 latency 190ms (+40ms WoW), P95 620ms (+120ms). Error rate 0.9% (was 1.4%). Spend this week ~$12.4k, projected ~$50k/mo if usage holds. KV cache hit ~12% (expected ~35%). Possible cause: new agent flow sends long-context prompts.

Dave (CSE): Noted. Can you paste the top endpoints + token distribution? Also did they switch model variants recently?

Maria (CS): No variant change on our side. Here's quick telemetry snapshot below from Telemetry Bot.

Telemetry Bot: Top endpoints (24h): /generate 67%, /embed 21%, /rerank 5%, /health 7%. Median tokens/request: 480. 24% requests >2048 tokens. 90th pct tokens/request: 2,300.

Ankit (AM): Heads-up — if the spend stays high and latency degrades our renewal convo in 3 weeks becomes riskier. Suggest we offer an enablement session + config changes before escalation.

Dave (CSE): Agreed. Immediate ops suggestions:
- Increase batch target for /generate from 8 -> 12 for their Dedicated queue.
- Enable prefix KV caching for the agent flow (should lift cache hit).
- Route heavy long-context requests to a cheaper model variant for now.

Maria (CS): Can we run a quick sample log pull? OpsBot, run the customer query.

OpsBot: Command issued: `rbx logs --customer=skyline-labs --span=24h --top-endpoints --token-dist`

OpsBot: Sample result (first 3 lines):
```
2026-02-25T08:12:03Z /generate  request_id=abc123 tokens_in=540 tokens_out=320 model=redwood-13b latency_ms=210 err=0
2026-02-25T09:03:19Z /generate  request_id=def456 tokens_in=2720 tokens_out=1580 model=redwood-13b latency_ms=890 err=0
2026-02-25T10:21:50Z /embed     request_id=ghi789 tokens_in=64  model=embed-1 latency_ms=120 err=0
```

Dave (CSE): That second line explains it — bursts of 2.7k token prompts are killing latency. We should:
1) Propose a rate-limit policy for >2048 token requests (soft-throttle + queued handling).
2) Add a canary route to a lower-memory model variant for oversized requests.

Maria (CS): I'll set up an enablement slot with their engs for tomorrow 10am PT. Also requesting a temporary burst cap from SRE (Ankit can approve billing communication).

Ankit (AM): Approved to request a temporary burst cap for next 7 days. I'll email billing + renewals team.

Maria (CS): Action items:
- Dave: config changes (batching + route) — target today
- Ops: run cache prefix tuning + re-run telemetry in 24h
- Ankit: billing + renewal note

Maria (CS): We'll reconvene Fri EOD with updated numbers. :thumbsup:
